fullPassage: Ivan Beltrami was born on June 14, 1920, in Marseille, France, to a family committed to medicine — his father was a doctor and his mother a nurse. Raised in a Catholic environment, he grew up valuing compassion and justice, particularly influenced by the discrimination faced by his Jewish friends. ④ (A) 복무하다 — (B) 제공하다 ←정답: serve as = ~로 복무하다, serve food = 음식을 제공하다
det.tip: serve: (1) ~로 일하다/복무하다 (serve as) (2) (음식을) 내다/제공하다 (serve food)

questions.stem: 다음 영영 정의에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은? "a person who carries messages or documents from one place to another"

det.korean: '한 곳에서 다른 곳으로 메시지나 문서를 운반하는 사람' = courier(연락책, 배달원).
det.analysis:
① guardian(보호자) — 보호하는 사람, 운반과 무관

③ courier ←정답 — 메시지/문서를 운반하는 사람. 본문 'served as a courier'와 일치

④ surgeon(외과의사) — 의료인이지만 메시지 운반과 무관
det.tip: courier = 연락책, 급사. 전시에는 비밀 메시지를 전달하는 역할.

det.analysis:

improve(원형) → improving(동명사). dedicate oneself to + V-ing 구문.

questions.passage: Ivan Beltrami was born on June 14, 1920, in Marseille, France, to a family committed to medicine — his father was a doctor and his mother a nurse. Raised in a Catholic environment, he grew up valuing compassion and justice, particularly influenced by the discrimination faced by his Jewish friends. During World War II, Beltrami studied medicine while secretly aiding the French Resistance. From 1942, he served as a courier and provided medical assistance to those in need. After the war, he dedicated himself to improving healthcare access in underserved communities, establishing clinics in rural areas of southern France. questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

① Nobel Peace Prize winner(노벨 평화상 수상자) — 본문 언급 없음

② Righteous Among the Nations ←정답 — 'honored as Righteous Among the Nations by Yad Vashem'. 야드 바셈의 열방의 의인 칭호

③ French Legion of Honor member(프랑스 레지옹 도뇌르 회원) — 본문 언급 없음

④ Medal of Honor recipient(명예훈장 수상자) — 미국 군사 훈장, 본문 언급 없음
det.tip: Righteous Among the Nations = 열방의 의인. 야드 바셈이 홀로코스트 시기 유대인 구출자에게 수여.
